tasting_notes: Intensely bitter herbal digestif made from a secret recipe of 27 herbs, roots and spices including aloe, gentian, rhubarb, chamomile, myrrh and saffron; eucalyptus-menthol lift over a dry, bracing bitterness.
Mint variant of Fernet-Branca created in the 1960s; the herb-and-spice base enriched with Piedmontese peppermint essential oil for a bittersweet, cooling menthol character.
Vibrant red bitter aperitivo from an infusion of herbs and fruit; signature bitter-orange and herbal profile, the heart of the Negroni and Americano. ABV varies by market (24% US, 25% EU/UK).

special_designation: Aperitif Liqueur; Cask Tales Bourbon Finish
tasting_notes: Limited edition launched 2019 for Davide Campari's 150th anniversary; classic Campari finished in ex-Wild Turkey No.4 'Alligator' char bourbon casks adding vanilla, smoky char and creamy caramel notes.

special_designation: Aperitif Liqueur; Cask Tales Rum Finish
tasting_notes: Cask Tales collection expression; Campari finished in ex-Appleton Estate Jamaica Rum casks bringing tropical notes that balance the bittersweet bitter.

special_designation: Aperitif Liqueur; Cask Tales Tequila Finish
tasting_notes: Cask Tales collection expression; Campari finished in ex-Espolon Mexican Tequila barrels imparting a slightly tart, herbal taste with notes of pepper and citrus.
Bittersweet low-alcohol orange aperitivo from an infusion of herbs, citrus and roots; recipe unchanged since 1919 in Padua. Bitter-orange, rhubarb and gentian notes; base of the Aperol Spritz.

Bitter artichoke-based amaro made from 13 herbs and plants, predominantly Cynara scolymus (artichoke); bittersweet, deeply herbal with notes of dark chocolate, walnut, allspice and cola. Launched 1952.
Higher-proof version released in the 2010s, made to the same secret recipe of 13 infused botanicals as the original but at greater strength for cocktail use.
Sicilian amaro made since 1868 from a blend of ~60 herbs, roots and citrus peels including licorice root, cinnamon, cloves and cardamom; rich, bittersweet with citrus and herbal depth.

Very limited edition (1868 bottles) honoring founder Salvatore Averna; same ~60 botanicals as the standard amaro but with longer 21-month maturation and higher strength. Rooty, woody, herbal with red berry, dark chocolate, vanilla and Christmas spice; complex, dry and bitter.
Italy's iconic amaro created by Stanislao Cobianchi in 1885; recipe of more than 40 botanicals. Smooth, gently bitter with orange, rose, vanilla and warm spice; versatile digestif and cocktail base.
The first amaro made in Italy, created 1815; bitter aperitif/digestif from 33 herbs including gentian and orange peel, with vibrant orange and bergamot notes.
Mixable bitter aperitivo with fresh notes of hibiscus and fruity orange blossom; pink-hued, designed for spritz-style serves.
Mint expression of Amaro Ramazzotti; intense fresh mint and menthol with a hint of citrus over the amaro base, clean refreshing finish.
The house's first cream liqueur, blending the Amaro Ramazzotti character with cream for a sweet, smooth profile.
Black sambuca produced with star anise and cinnamon; slightly thicker, richer palate and softer finish than white sambuca.
Botanical recipe including gentian, saffron, licorice, rhubarb, sweet and bitter orange, tamarind, quassia bark, cinchona bark and galangal; aged minimum 1 year on a base of UE grape distillate.

Fresh and fruity with citrous notes and scents of soft fruits, lightly bitter; infusion of botanicals ennobled by UE Grape Distillate Fragolino Monovitigno.

Dense, dark brown; strong aromas of bitter herbs and dried fruit (chestnuts, walnut husk), coffee and honey; honey sweetness followed by intense bitter tannic taste, long finish. Decoction of herbs, roots and barks cooked over wood fire, sweetened with honey.

Tobacco colour with brick-red shades, opaque; aromas of stewed ripe fruit and sultana, gentian, rhubarb, sandalwood and honey; dry, bitter, warm with powerful tannic structure. Decoction of herbs, roots and barks over wood fire, sweetened only with pure honey.

Secret recipe of more than 30 herbs (including wormwood, gentian, holy thistle); created 1894.
Premium version flavoured with more than 30 herbs including wormwood, gentian and holy thistle; created to mark the company's 120th anniversary.

Mint-flavoured version of the more-than-30-herb Amaro Lucano recipe.
Selection of 29 Calabrian herbs, spices, roots, fruits and flowers including sweet and bitter oranges, tangerines, chamomile, juniper, licorice, anise, mint and hyssop.
Intense amber; aromas of citrus, candied fruit, saffron, cinnamon, licorice and vanilla; built on brandy aged 30-50 years in Slovenian oak blended with 29 Calabrian botanicals.
Original Amaro del Capo recipe of 29 Calabrian botanicals combined with the pungent heat of Calabrian chilli pepper.
Member of the amari family distinguished by higher ABV and lower sugar content than typical liqueurs.
Authentic Italian amaretto since 1851, made and bottled in Saronno according to an old family recipe.

Extractions from 15 alpine and Mediterranean herbs (notably gentian, hand-peeled bitter orange peel, marine wormwood Santonico) in pure grape distillate; matured in ash-wood barrels; complex, balanced, bitter-orange aftertaste with sweet spice finish.
Digestif traditionally served neat or on the rocks after a meal; saffron-and-herb character.
Sweet but not cloying; rich, complex anise flavour with nuances of aromatic herbs and a slight licorice aftertaste.
Bitter aperitivo-style liqueur.

Grappa with added cherry distillate and bitter almond extracts.
Made with grappa, sour cherry, orange and herbs.
Brings out the freshness of citron fruit, with an intense citrusy aroma.
Natural infusion of digestive plants, herbs and flowers in grappa and alcohol; Veneto amaro.

Liqueur of Poli grappa flavoured with acacia blossom honey and herbal oil essences; aromas of blooming meadow and alpine wood, sweet but not too intense.

distillery: Distilleria Santa Teresa dei F.lli Marolo
tasting_notes: Chamomile flowers picked fully ripe and steeped 11 months in Nebbiolo grappa; soothing floral character.
Alpine amaro made with over 20 Alpine herbs including gentian, thyme, mint, yarrow, achillea, wormwood and juniper; whole botanicals crushed on-site, no extracts. Born in Bormio 1875.
Aged minimum 24 months in small oak barriques at higher ABV, then milder filtration; Alpine herbal recipe.
Built on Chinese rhubarb root grown in Trentino and Veneto; smoky, rich rabarbaro character. Made in house by the fourth-generation Cappelletti family.
On a base of rich aged wine: notes of blueberries, pine and smoke with bitter alpine herbs. Recipe dates to the early 20th century.
Chinese rhubarb root macerated with bitter orange peel, cardamom and a proprietary botanical blend; smoky-amber, earthy-tart bitterness. Created by Ettore Zucca, Milan, 1845.

Wine-based amaro flavoured with cardoon (Cardo Gobbo di Nizza Monferrato) and blessed thistle plus a secret blend of botanicals; rested minimum 6 months in oak. Marketed as 'the only Italian amaro wine.'
Composed of 36 herbs, spices, flowers, roots and plants from four continents; aged about a year and a half. Recipe unchanged since 1858, originating with Franciscan monks in Genoa.
Cold maceration of 14 selected botanicals (including cinchona, rhubarb and citrus) in grain alcohol, no additives or colorants. Created 2015 in San Basilio, Rome.
Calabrian amaro/aperitivo-bitter.
Classic fernet-style herbal amaro.
Dark amaro from the infusion of 18 types of herbs; original recipe from 1871, reformulated 1989.
Herbal liqueur built around the aromatic bitterness of cinchona (china) bark, balanced with Mediterranean herbs, spices and citrus peels.
Amber amaro obtained through both infusion and distillation of aromatic herbs; one of the historic Turin liqueur houses.

distillery: Distillerie Alpine St. Roch Levi Ottoz
tasting_notes: Hydro-alcoholic infusion of Genepy (alpine Artemisia) for about a month, aged 6 months in steel; Valle d'Aosta alpine herbal liqueur.
Distillate of about 70 herbs and spices including Ceylon cinnamon, Florentine iris, Apennine juniper, Samnite mint; saffron-colored, aged in ash barrels.
Classic Strega aged many years in ash barrels; long aging balances aromas, soft and delectable.
Soft liqueur from fresh milk combined with Strega liqueur; velvety, delicate, ivory color.
Dark amber; pleasantly bitter with notes of bitter orange, cinchona, gentian and rhubarb.
High-quality sambuca with added star anise spirit; sweet, warm, harmonious with long anise persistence; crystalline color.
Dark sambuca; pleasantly sweet, intense and rich with persistent anise note; dark color with purple reflexes.
Sweet spices, Madagascar bourbon vanilla and cocoa liquor; sweet with a hint of almond brittle; amber color.
Infusion of selected lemon peels; intense aroma, rich velvety juicy flavor; bright yellow.
Combines sweetness of chocolate with Strega liqueur character; served at room temperature, warm with cream, or over ice cream.
Made with Amarelli licorice (Rossano Calabro) juice extracted from roots, combined with Alberti herb/spice flavors.
Premium coffee liqueur from infusion of 100% Arabica coffee; intense, smooth, enveloping coffee flavor.
Apricot-kernel base; smooth, warmly sweet with almond, vanilla and dried-fruit character.
Disaronno Originale blended with fresh cream; incredibly smooth, velvety; served over ice.

Limited edition (2015, ~10,000 bottles); Disaronno blended with young Scotch and aged ~6 months in Marsala casks. Spicy sweetness into vanilla-almond, peppery dried-fruit finish. Discontinued/limited.
30+ botanicals (juniper, star anise, cinnamon, lavender, Madagascar vanilla); anise and peppermint to the fore, fresh herbs, cinnamon, ginger, nutmeg, citrus; lingering vanilla.
55% Arabica (Colombia/Brazil) + 45% Robusta (India/Kenya); intense, close to a strong caffe corretto with dark-chocolate-covered roasted coffee beans. Successor to Galliano Ristretto coffee liqueur.
Heart of Galliano L'Autentico (Mediterranean anise, cardamom, lavender, peppermint, cinnamon) with high-quality vanilla distillate; round scent, sweet vanilla flavor.

Mediterranean citrus (oranges, bergamot, bitter orange, chinotto, tangerine, grapefruit) plus L'Autentico elements; crimson; orange/grapefruit zest, black pepper, quinine, vanilla; well-balanced bittersweet.

Hazelnut liqueur; toasted hazelnut with cocoa and vanilla notes.
Intense green herbal liqueur with aromas of oregano, thyme and pinesap; dry, strong, bitter; herbs from Mount Morrone.
Sweet orange liqueur from aged brandy and citrus infusion (orange rind, orange juice, saffron); deep golden color.
Marasca cherries infused in larchwood vats, distilled in copper pot stills, heart matured in ashwood; 1821 recipe.

Marasca cherry-juice liqueur, naturally fermented and aged in oak; clear deep burgundy red; pungent fresh cherry juice with faint white pepper and marzipan; intense, thick, syrupy.
Almond flavor from essential oils in cherry, peach and apricot pits; well-rounded, fragrant aroma, hint of vanilla on the finish.
Herbal amaro from seven botanicals incl. cardamom, cinnamon, bitter orange peel; introduced 1952.
Infusion of southern Italian lemon peels, pulp and juice; original family recipe (advertised 1905); bright citrus.
Triple sec from distillation of dried peels of three citrus (curacao bitter orange, sweet orange, mandarin); heart-cut redistilled; orange flowers, pennyroyal, vervain.
Balanced infusion of herbs, roots and citrus fruits; mild ABV (also offered at 15%); bright orange-crimson; bittersweet orange/rhubarb/gentian.
Classic red bitter (first made 1885); infusion of mint, marjoram, thyme, bitter orange.
Near-transparent bitter (released 2017, reviving a 1930s recipe); rhubarb, cardamom, mint, marjoram, thyme, bitter orange, wormwood.
Strong bitter amaro; prolonged infusion of licorice, cardamom, gentian, saffron; produced since 1889.
30-day infusion of fine coffees (Brazil, Colombia, Kenya), Arabica predominating; served neat chilled or on the rocks.
Essential oils from steam-distilled star anise seeds; star anise, herbs/spices, sugar and Luxardo spring water; sweet, strong, lifted anise with licorice.

Super-premium sambuca; the only Italian sambuca legally permitted to use the word 'Extra'; intense star anise and licorice character.
Distinctive, flavorful Italian anise liqueur; clean white sambuca with pronounced anise sweetness.
Infused with witch elder bush and licorice; thick, sweet, viscous palate with pronounced licorice and herbal character; oily, long, aromatic finish.
Black sambuca flavored with liquorice; violet-black color; dominant star anise with Mediterranean licorice-anise character.
Flavored with Chinese star anise and Mediterranean anise; nose of liquorice root, allspice and fennel; bittersweet palate of liquorice, aniseed and pepper; peppery, spicy finish.
Black sambuca flavored with Chinese star and Mediterranean anise; midnight-blue hue from licorice extract added during distillation.
Classic Italian digestif made in northern Venice from natural ingredients; blend of star anise distillate, essential oils and white sugar; IWSC Silver 2013.
Deep purplish-black; bold star anise and Calabrian liquorice; full-bodied, smooth, sweet with herbal spice; long liquorice finish.
Sweet, fruity, fragrant; classic sambuca star anise with crushed raspberry; berry and elderflower perfumes moving into star anise, fennel, cinnamon, wormwood, cardamom.
Classically intense and well-flavored, with big sweet notes of anise and complex herbal touches.
Non-vintage, unaged; derives aroma and flavor from star anise.
Produced with star anise, orris root, coriander, Turkish rose, elderberry and ambrette; sweet, fruity and spicy with powerful anise flavor.
Sweet, strong liqueur; base of essential oils from steam distillation of star anise seeds with concentrated sugar and natural aromas.

Produced with an extended step where elderflower-bush fruit is steeped in alcohol at cold temperatures, then 4 months in stainless steel; floral underlying character.
Fresh and intense lemon aroma; melts into freshness on the palate without burning the mouth. Made with Sfusato IGP lemons from the Amalfi Coast.
Zesty lemon with citrus acidity softened by creamy mouthfeel; creamy zesty lemon aftertaste. Dairy-free/vegan, made with Amalfi Coast lemons.
Tawny red; aromatic raspberry and raspberry tart; clean fruity intense cooked raspberry and blueberry with tart acidity. Made with wild raspberries, blueberries and blackcurrants from Abruzzo.
Made with white peaches from Emilia Romagna's orchards.
Hazy pale golden yellow; pungent freshly grated lemon zest aroma; clean zesty lemon with cleansing citric acidity balancing light sweetness; long lemony finish. Made with Sorrento IGP lemons.
Bright light yellow; fragrant intense aromas of lemon zest; sweet, delicate and velvety with a pleasantly bitter aftertaste. Lemon-zest infusion blended with milk cream; Sorrento lemon IGP peels.

spirit_name: Villa Massa Liquore di Mandarini di Sorrento
tasting_notes: Tangerine/mandarin liqueur made with Sorrento mandarins; alternative to the classic limoncello, sipped after a meal.
Made from lemon peels of Sicilian and Amalfi Coast lemons following the 1898 Sperone family recipe; no artificial flavours or extracts.

Cloudy bright yellow; pungent zesty lemon and lemon meringue pie filling; sharp cleansing zesty lemon and citrus acidity with light sweetness. Canale family recipe using Sorrento IGP lemons. (Strength reduced from 32% to 30% in 2022.)
Sweet and zesty; Femminello lemon peel infused ~30 days in alcohol, then sugar and a splash of grappa added. Served chilled after dinner.
Waxy lemons, a little vanilla and a hint of sugared almonds. Made naturally by steeping natural lemon peel in alcohol, without preservatives or colouring.
Bright yellow with intense aromas of fresh lemons; made using selected Italian lemon peels.
Low-ABV limoncello aperitivo made from Sicilian Femminello lemons; produced at the company's Franciacorta distillery in Lombardy.
Organic limoncello made with sun-ripened coastal Sicilian lemons; not overly sweet, retaining some acidity. Rated 90 Falstaff points.

Deep ruby-red Venetian bitter from a secret blend of 30 botanicals led by juniper and rhubarb root; notes of vanilla, sweet citrus, lavender, bitter orange peel and raspberry. The original Venetian Spritz bitter since 1920.
Bergamot rosolio; Calabrian bergamot and Sicilian cedro extracted by cold sfumatura with Italian flowers; fragrant citrus, bergamot, herbal bitterness and a suggestion of sweetness. Launched 2016.

distillery_location: San Marzano di San Giuseppe, Italy
tasting_notes: Traditional Puglian elixir dating to 1840; rich blend of herbs, roots and spices including melissa, wormwood, cloves and saffron macerated in pure alcohol; warm, spiced, bittersweet.

Real Italian espresso liqueur from an 1860 Ugo Borghetti recipe, made with Arabica and Robusta beans via a large-scale moka method; Italy's best-selling coffee liqueur. Produced by Fratelli Branca. 25% ABV.
Nose of lemon balm, bergamot, citrus peel and gentian; palate of bright bergamot balanced by floral lavender and rose, light honey, chamomile, and a subtle bitter-herbal backbone.
